source: inventor I-05 'Aerotow camera'; rounds 1–2; audit 2026-10-19; re-audit audit2 2026-10-20 (A2-TG-01..08, A2-X-01..10); ROUND3_BRIEF.md + ITERATE_BRIEF.md
evidence_boundary: Numerical-uncalibrated simulation (sim/js/concepts/towglider) and an illustrative animation driven by the same physics. No physical test was run. Coefficients ASSUMED unless a source is cited. Masses/powers from common/components.js plus this concept's design.js.

where_the_28pct_went (round 2, calm_s11,.finding: the KE cap did not bind (glider ground speed p95 13.5 < 14.0 m/s governor); px and launch did

redesign_round3: Camera: same Thumb 2 class camera (shared cam4kNoGimbal, 27 g) recording 4K 4:3 (3840×2880, 30 fps per retailer spec) through a 66° HFOV M12 rectilinear lens (ASSUMED custom lens swap, like kite2's 60° optic) → 1.47× the native px/rad of the 90° fisheye.

Mount: the 3 servos (EMAX ES9251 II class, 2.5 g, 0.08 s/60°) now close the loop on world attitude with FC-IMU feed-forward (servo gimbal): body rotation leaks only above f_s = 4 Hz (ASSUMED) + 0.15° deadband noise; the crop keeps a 5° pointing margin inside the sensor window.

Footage is rendered after the run (Gyroflow-style: gyro EIS 8 % residual + zero-phase 2 Hz subject reframing with 1 % detection noise, bounded by the sensor window); auto-zoom keeps the whole subject incl. skis within 80 % of the half frame.

Station copies the hip's line (latK 1, 1.2 s centreline, 0.3 s along-track) so the camera distance stays ≈5–8 m; above 13.3 m/s rider speed it blends back to a straighter line (less ground speed under the KE governor).
Launch: line pays out 4.5 m (park also at 4.5 m); footage counts from 0.8 m; the parked glider films the standing/pushing-off rider from the snow; the KE governor now also caps the winch.

Stops: zoom-up (≤1 m) and side-step 6 m back / 7 m to the side the stopped rider's back faces, filming until the rider is still; deep-stall drop after; constant 1 N line tension in wind > 4 m/s and slack take-up (≤0.5 N) while parked so a slack line cannot bow towards the head.

Holster moved from the hip to behind the seat (80 mm hard tube on a belt swivel clamp, 37° below horizontal): leash exit ≥1.1 m from the helmet centre and ≥0.23 m above the snow at a 45° carving lean (thigh position rejected: 0.14 m).

Packing: each wing panel swings aft AND folds at 55 % chord (rear chord incl. split flap folds under, +3 g hinges, +0.003 cd0), tail boom telescopes; section 56 × 53 mm → 80 mm OD × 0.46 m holster = 2.30 L; total 2.80 L (round-2 fold would need a 110 mm tube, 4.9 L).

Conductor: 2 × 7/44 AWG Cu litz on a 0.17 mm UHMWPE core + PU jacket: 0.60 mm OD, 0.40 g/m, 1.3 Ω/m per conductor (computed from ASTM B258 strand size + IACS Cu, +5 % lay); drag of the thicker line is in the model.

Wind gates on the shared windEstimate() (no oracle): no launch at ≥4.5 m/s estimated down-slope wind, re-evaluated at every push-off; airspeed-margin rule (rider speed − estimated tailwind ≥5.8 m/s) delays the winch launch and, in flight, drops the glider to wait on the snow (sled tow) — no slow-rider stall; a parked glider whose relaunch is refused is pulled into the holster.

operating_envelope.wind: calm/head/cross to 9 m/s: launched-run availability 85–91 %; down-slope (tail) wind ≥≈4.5 m/s estimated: no launch (6/39 cases count 0) — a gravity glider cannot hold station above its stall speed; forcing it gives KE 15.6–18.2 J, releases and head passes 0.07–0.78 m (tailwindGateProof). In 9 m/s gusty wind the 1-s-old shared estimate can refuse the first launch (crossL9_s13/crossR9_s13: 40 %, filming resumes after the rest stop).
operating_envelope.rider_speed_note: ≥15 m/s the rider's along-track speed exceeds the 13.8 m/s KE governor (KE cap 15.0 m/s at 132 g): the glider lags and releases before the spool end (KE ≤13 J). Whole run at 14 m/s: 64.6 % calm. Raising the cap needs a lighter airframe (not done).
operating_envelope.slow riders: 6–8 m/s in calm/light wind fly (segments 100 %), but the whole-run 6 m/s beginner shows head clearance 0.79 m and jitter 3.4 °/s at stops (outside: riders ≥7–8 m/s); with a 3 m/s tailwind riders <10 m/s get no footage (margin rule, safe: KE ≤9.5 J, head ≥0.98 m).
operating_envelope.terrain: 10–20° groomed; expert 20° at 13 m/s 60.5 %; 24–28° at 14–15 m/s outside; moguls 4.5 m/s 54 % (margin rule, head 0.55 m — outside)

honest_limits: 39-case mean availability 72.1 % FAILS 80 %: every never-launched tailwind run counts 0; launched runs 85.2 % mean (p10 85.4). No design change found that follows ≥4.5 m/s tailwinds within KE ≤14.9 J and stall margin.

Shared jitter p90 1.92 °/s passes but rests on ASSUMED values: EIS residual 8 % (15 % → 2.99, 25 % → 4.65 °/s), mount bandwidth 4 Hz (2 Hz → 2.92), servo deadband 0.15° (0.5° → 3.57 °/s FAIL). No published gyro-EIS residual ratio was found (Karpenko et al. 2011 is the method reference, not a number).

headClear ensemble min 1.01 m passes with 1 cm margin (crossL9_s12 rest stop, slack line in a gust); excluding only a ≤2.4 s dock-capture window. Leash 1 m behind the rider is only 0.12–0.3 m above the snow while carving (hip-height exit at 45° lean): trip/entanglement hazard for following skiers; a higher exit fails headClear — inherent trade-off of a body-anchored leash.
4K 4:3 at 30 fps (retailer spec; '3840x2160 (4:3)' wording is ambiguous) and the 66° M12 lens are ASSUMED; a 60° lens gives +3 pt on the representative case (less near-range margin).
Post-processing reframing means footage is not live; clip quality also depends on rolling-shutter wobble (not modelled) and motion blur (1 ms).

Stop/park/capture mechanics (deep-stall entry, snow pull into a holster behind the seat, swivel for the chairlift) are unverified; the shared skier stops abruptly (5–6 m/s → 0), which drives the stop clearances.
Compute ≈1.8–2.3 s per case (above the 1.5 s guide).

regulation_gate.EU: 132 g <250 g: open A1/C0 if marketed so; operator registration; 15 m leash = physical geofence.
regulation_gate.US: VLOS by a skiing operator not credible — gate.
regulation_gate.resorts: written permission gate; no contact made.

round4.basis: results.json (towglider@0.5.0), shared round-4 rules (FULLRUN_CASES_R4, bodyPx, ARTEFACT_PX 2, helmetAt, no idealised actuators)
round4.evidence_boundary: numerical-uncalibrated simulation; no part built or measured; G-MATURE closed, M-070 not_run

changes.what: Line-guide wand: 0.35 m Ø3 mm glass-fibre rod hinged at the holster mouth, ceramic eyelet at the tip; the leash exits ≈0.85 m behind the pelvis
changes.why: a leash from a point P can never clear the helmet by more than |P–helmet| (the 0.55 m tail-holster mouth sat 1.19–1.25 m from the helmet, so a steep line in a stop passed 0.99–1.0 m); the eyelet is 1.36–1.43 m from the helmet
changes.cost: ≈8 g, folds along the holster for the last metre of a stow (declared capture window); trip exposure higher than the round-3 holster (see trip)
changes.rigidMemberToHelmet_m: 1.36 min (fh2 geometry check over the shared run, all lean/crouch states)

changes.why: audit3 A3-TG-01: a refused relaunch snow-pulled the glider at 18 m/s (21.8 J) — short line + swinging hip = whip
changes.how: when the glider’s own 0.1 s-filtered GNSS/IMU ground speed exceeds 0.95 × the KE-governor speed the drum stops pulling (0.05 N free pay-out) in every snow / winch / drop mode

changes.what: Pre-emptive rest-stop stow (gateHyst 1 m/s) and fast pull at a refused push-off
changes.why: never drag a parked glider in behind a moving rider

changes.what: Tailwind gate 3.0 m/s (was 4.5) on the shared windEstimate
changes.why: with the shared ±1 m/s bias a launch can see gate + 1 m/s true tailwind; forced launches (6 seeds): 2.5–4 m/s true KE ≤13.139 J, headClear min 0.889 m (worst rows: [{"id": "tail3.5_s16", "avail": 82.947, "keMax": 12.43, "headClear": 0.889, "ops": 1}, {"id": "tail4.5_s12", "avail": 68.481, "keMax": 12.877, "headClear": 0.594, "ops": 1}, {"id": "tail4.5_s14", "avail": 75.835, "keMax": 13.389, "headClear": 0.758, "ops": 1}, {"id": "tail5_s11", "avail": 21.74, "keMax": 17.027, "headClear": 1.301, "ops": 3}]); 4.5–6 m/s true: KE up to 18.44 J, headClear down to 0.374 m, releases/cuts; a glider cannot decelerate with a stopping rider in a tailwind

changes.what: Anti-sag tow floor fades from 0.8 N to 0.15 N with the tailwind estimate
changes.why: a 0.8 N forward pull made the glider overrun stopping riders in 3–4 m/s tailwinds (headClear 0.78–0.86 m in the forced sweep)

changes.what: Deferred launch (≤8 s after push-off, rider <6 m/s) once a refusing estimate clears
changes.why: A3-TG-03 false refusals at t≈1 s; launches at higher rider speed passed 0.45 m from the head (crossL9_s13), so the deferral is capped at 6 m/s and the s13 cross cases still lose the first ride

changes.what: Zoom-assisted in-flight KE governor (surplus traded for ≤2 m height) and the 0.8 N tow floor drops to 0.15 N while it acts
changes.why: airbrake authority ∝ q is weak at low airspeed
a 0.6 mm line at 0.15 N in 12 m/s flow sags 0.4–1.2 m (lay on the snow 2–3 m behind the rider while following)

changes.what: 50° M12 lens (was 66°), body framing (cropFillBody 0.65, skis within 0.93 of the half-frame), crop aimed at the subject box centre (0.25 Hz)
changes.why: avail is now judged on bodyPx: at 66° the launched avail fell to 63 % (resolution-limited, ski tail set the zoom)

changes.what: Physical 3-servo mount + component EIS residual (attitude.js SERVO/EIS)
changes.why: A3-TG-04 / A3-X-08: the 8 % EIS ratio and the 0.15° random dead band were assumptions, not models

changes.what: Lift-ride sleep mode (0.05 W) charged in endurance
Overspeed escape (turn into the wind and stow) and a tailwind turn-away stop variant
changes.status: overspeed escape kept as last resort (did not make 5–5.5 m/s safe); the turn-away stop variant was tested and REJECTED (worse head clearance than the zoom drop: 0.38–0.74 m at 3–4.5 m/s)

endurance.note: usable Wh / (mean full-run hip energy + 8 min lift ride in sleep mode 0.05 W) × mean filming s per run; noSleep = lift ride idling at 0.6 W

availBound.note: avail mean over 48 = Σ case avail / 48; gated (never-launched) cases count 0. Even if every case incl. tail 9 m/s flew at the launched mean the ensemble would only reach the launched mean.

honest_limits: avail FAILS: 49.409 % over 48 (launched runs 76.504 %); every case with ≥3 m/s estimated tailwind is refused because following there is not safe; even if every case flew at the launched mean the 48-case mean would be 76.504 %

tail 9 m/s is physically closed for this wing loading: the slowest ground speed through a downwind reversal is 9 + 5.4 (flap stall) = 14.4 m/s ≈ 13.7 J, above the 13.8 m/s governor with any margin; ≥4.5 m/s true tail fails head clearance in stops (the glider cannot decelerate with the rider)
jitter rests on a ≥6 Hz small-signal servo bandwidth with the camera load and ≤5 ms FC latency: 3 Hz → p90 6.297, 50 Hz analog PWM → 3.609, all pessimistic → 7.656 °/s
beginners (6 m/s), short turns and moguls stay outside the envelope
